text:
Renee: Quick design check  added a compact 'Timeline + Preview' in the SLO threshold editor to show suppression windows inline. Figma: https://figma.redwood/slo-suppression-timeline (WIP)
Tom - Eng: Looks useful. Implementation note: cap expanded occurrences to 30 days to avoid heavy RRULE computation.
Ava (PM): Copy nit: change the small header from 'Suppression timeline' to 'Suppression schedule'  clearer for users.
Renee: Good call. Also thinking of a visual hatch pattern option for color-blind users on overlapping segments.
Leo - A11y: Accessibility: timeline segments need keyboard focus and an SR summary of next 3 windows. Announce when a preset is toggled: 'Suppression enabled: Nightly Quiet, 23:00 to 07:00'.
Tom - Eng: Perf: avatars in channel preview cause reflow on long lists. Suggest initials fallback and lazy-load images in sim mode.
Ava (PM): Mobile behavior: timeline collapses to a stacked list with a chevron to expand details. The preview becomes a full-screen sheet.
Renee: For the preview helper copy I'm proposing: 'Preview only  no messages will be sent'. Short enough?
Leo - A11y: Short is good, but add aria-describedby linking to expandable details that explain the simulation behaviour.
DesignBot: Checklist added: [ ] rename header, [ ] add SR summary, [ ] cap to 30d, [ ] pattern overlay for colorblind, [ ] lazy-load avatars, [ ] mobile sheet.
Renee: Thanks! If anyone has an even shorter pill label for tiny screens (2-4 chars) drop suggestions.
